Orbit

Plan less. Focus more.

03

Questions

How much does a website cost?

It depends on the number of pages, the features and the languages. Email us a short description and we’ll reply with a quote within two working days.

Where are you based? Do you work remotely?

We work remotely with clients across Australia and overseas, by email and video call.

Can you build a website in both English and Chinese?

Yes. We write and check both languages ourselves, and set the site up so each language can be found on Google.

Will my website show up on Google?

Every site we build comes with the basics: page titles and descriptions, a sitemap, structured data, fast loading and a mobile layout. Ranking for competitive searches also takes content and time, and we’ll tell you what is realistic.

Can you host and maintain the website after launch?

Yes. We can register the domain, host the site and make changes when you need them, or hand everything over to you.
